# FNIC — School Operating System

FNIC is an AI-powered school management platform (ERP) used internally by
school staff — principals, teachers, accountants, front-office/reception,
and administrators — to manage students, attendance, fees, payroll,
timetables, communications, and reporting for a single school organization.

This is an authenticated, internal business application, not a public
website or content platform. Nearly all functionality requires a staff
login issued by the school's administrator; there is no public signup,
and no content here is intended for general public indexing or reuse.

## Access

- Sign in: https://fnicschool.com/login
- Account recovery: https://fnicschool.com/recover-account
- System status: https://fnicschool.com/status

## Contact

This platform has no public support desk. Staff with access issues should
contact their school administrator directly (see the "Need Help?" link on
the sign-in page).
